products.name: Sysracks 22U 39 in Deep IT & Telecom Cabinet (SRF 22.6.10)
products.summary: 22U, 39-inch-deep enclosed floor cabinet with glass door, thermostat-controlled fans and brush inlets.
products.description: The Sysracks SRF 22.6.10 is a 22U floor-standing IT cabinet, 24 in wide and 39 in deep with a glass front door and detachable side panels. Welded frames are rated to 1,600 lb, brush cable inlets sit top and bottom, four rails adjust up to 34 in apart, and a thermostat switches the fan panel on as temperatures rise.

specs.rackType: Enclosed floor cabinet, 39 in deep, glass door

products.name: Sysracks 12U 24 in Deep Wall-Mount Enclosure (SRW 12.600 G)
products.summary: 12U, 24-inch-deep grey wall-mount cabinet with glass door and removable locking side panels.
products.description: The Sysracks SRW 12.600 G is a 12U, 24 x 24 in wall-mount 19-inch enclosure in grey with a glass front door, push lock, brush cable inlet and lockable, removable side and rear panels. Rails with U-marking adjust up to 20 in apart and included feet let it stand on the floor.
